SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, COUNT(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_GR_COUNT FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , DELY_TO_LOCATION , RO_QTY , RO_AMT , REMARK , '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_GR_COUNT FROM V_KEP_GR, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND KEY_3 = LEGACY_GR_NO AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_NUMBER(LEGACY_GR_SEQ), LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_NUMBER(LEGACY_PO_SEQ)
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', KEY_6 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', KEY_6 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
